description: Retail end-credit data table whose rows pair literal credit text (or blank spacers) with a content category, alignment and typography values, plus four booleans named for the main, short, first-DLC and second-DLC credit variants. The reconstructed C++ does not identify a reader of this table, so variant and styling effects remain data/name evidence rather than proven runtime behavior.

Id.simple: Credit-line row identifier (exported as ID; native member Id).
Id.technical: FName at retail offset 0x8; the reconstructed constructor does not list it, so its implicit default is the empty FName. The export's Properties.ImportKeyField is Id, and every one of the 2549 row keys equals its serialized ID. Keys use three retail naming families: CREDIT_<n>_10, CREDIT_SHORT_<n>_10 and CREDIT_SHOET_DLC1/2_<n>_10 (the SHOET spelling is present in the data). No C++ lookup by this name or CreditDataTable row read was identified.

LineNumber.simple: Nominal line or order value within a credit block.
LineNumber.technical: int32 at retail offset 0x10, constructor default 0. Export values are 1 on 2547 rows, 3 only on CREDIT_0003_10 and 0 only on CREDIT_0508_10; it is not a unique global order, and no consumer establishes how or whether it orders rows.

ContentType.simple: Kind of credit line (title, section, company, job, name, image, spacer, etc.).
ContentType.technical: EGameCreditContentType : uint8 at retail offset 0x14 (None=0, Title=1, Company=2, Section=3, Job=4, Name=5, Image=6, Space=7, Invalid=255), constructor default None. The export uses Company (19), Job (616), Name (1225), Section (52), Space (617) and Title (20); None, Image and Invalid do not occur. All Space rows have empty Text, but 46 Name rows are empty too, so empty Text does not identify a spacer. No table consumer proves the behavioral meaning of the categories.

Justify.simple: Text alignment stored for the credit line.
Justify.technical: TEnumAsByte<ETextJustify::Type> at retail offset 0x15, constructor default Left. Export counts are Center (2101), Left (365) and Right (83). The 83 Right rows are exactly the 83 Job rows with FontSize -1, LineHeightPercentage 1.01 and LetterSpacing -100; alignment is not a one-to-one content-type rule (Jobs also use Center/Left, Names use Center/Left, and some Titles and Spaces use Left). Generic UMG uses this enum, but no code links the exported field to a text widget.

FontSize.simple: Font-size value stored for the line when overridden.
FontSize.technical: int32 at retail offset 0x18, constructor default 0. Exported values are -1 on 2539 rows, 40 on the two main Title rows CREDIT_0001_10 and CREDIT_0003_10, and 30 on eight Title rows across the main, short and DLC key families. -1 is consistent with an inherit/default sentinel, but no consumer proves that convention or the unit; the reconstructed row only stores the int32.

LineHeightPercentage.simple: Line-height value stored for the credit text.
LineHeightPercentage.technical: float at retail offset 0x1C, constructor default 0.0f. Export counts are 1.0 (2172 rows), 0.0 (292), 1.01 (83, the same Right-justified Job rows with LetterSpacing -100) and 100.0 only on CREDIT_0002_10 and CREDIT_0004_10, both Space rows. No consumer confirms the unit, whether 0.0 means automatic/inherit, or why 100.0 appears; generic UMG text code uses a same-named float, but that code was not tied to this table.

LetterSpacing.simple: Extra character spacing stored for the credit line.
LetterSpacing.technical: int32 at retail offset 0x20, constructor default 0. Export counts are 0 (2123), -100 (83, exactly the Right-justified Job rows), 42 (2 Titles), 450 (49 Jobs), 856 (108 Names), 885 (44 Names), 1250 (2 Titles), 1290 (36 Names), 1318 (2 Titles) and 1320 (100 Names). Positive values are therefore not exclusive to Name rows. The unit and any widget mapping are unproven because no table reader was identified.

Text.simple: Literal credit text, or an empty spacer.
Text.technical: FString at retail offset 0x28, constructor default empty. Non-empty export values are final display strings (names, companies, jobs and a Title containing a newline), not localization IDs; 663 rows are empty: all 617 Space rows plus 46 Name rows. The export contains no alternate localization of this table, and no runtime formatter or ID resolver for this field was found.

IsMain.simple: Marks a row for the main/full credit variant.
IsMain.technical: bool at retail offset 0x38; the reconstructed constructor defaults it to false, and the retail BoolProperty SetBit thunk pins that byte offset. Export: 2216 true, 333 false. Most true rows are the unprefixed CREDIT_<n>_10 family; CREDIT_0001_10 and CREDIT_0004_10 are also flagged for all four variants. No C++ consumer of the flag was identified.

IsShort.simple: Marks a row for the short credit variant.
IsShort.technical: bool at retail offset 0x39, constructor default false; retail SetBit offset pin. Export: 150 true (146 exclusively short plus CREDIT_0001_10, CREDIT_0002_10, CREDIT_0003_10 and CREDIT_0004_10) and 2399 false. The reconstructed widget has a short panel selected by credit type 1, but no code reads this flag or links it to that panel.

IsDlc1.simple: Marks a row for the first DLC credit variant.
IsDlc1.technical: bool at retail offset 0x3A, constructor default false; retail SetBit offset pin. Export: 60 true (58 exclusively DLC1 plus CREDIT_0001_10 and CREDIT_0004_10) and 2489 false. Credit type 2 selects a prebuilt DLC1 panel in the widget, but no code reads this flag or links it to that panel.

IsDlc2.simple: Marks a row for the second DLC credit variant.
IsDlc2.technical: bool at retail offset 0x3B, constructor default false; retail SetBit offset pin. Export: 130 true (128 exclusively DLC2 plus CREDIT_0001_10 and CREDIT_0004_10) and 2419 false. Credit type 3 selects a prebuilt DLC2 panel, but no code reads this flag or links it to that panel.

notes: No identifiable C++ reader of FGameDataTableRow_Credit or CreditDataTable was found: Source has no FindRow/lookup using this struct, no CreditDataTables cache, and CreditDataTable is absent from the explicit table-name list in AGameDataTableManager::StartInitialLoading and from the DTM table arrays. The generic /Game/DataTables 'DataTable' PrimaryAssetType scan (Config/DefaultGame.ini:24) and the M4 registry entry /Game/DataTables/CreditDataTable explain that the asset exists/is cooked, not that a row reader exists.

The reconstructed credit runtime selects among four BindWidget panels in UGameCreditWidget::SetCreditType (0 default, 1 short, 2 DLC1, 3 DLC2), scrolls the active panel, and reads BgmDataTable Duration values (BGM_DEMO_07 minus 3.5 s, and BGM_DEMO_01) for timing. That is verified reconstructed widget behavior, but it does not consume CreditDataTable. The available Content/export has no WBP_Credit Blueprint internals or table reference, so no Blueprint-side binding is asserted.

The sole export contains one DataTable asset named CreditDataTable, 2549 unique row keys and no shards or localized siblings; every ID equals its row key. Row names follow main/short/SHOET_DLC1/SHOET_DLC2 families, and the flags are almost always mutually exclusive. Exceptions are CREDIT_0001_10 and CREDIT_0004_10 (all four), CREDIT_0002_10 and CREDIT_0003_10 (main+short only), and CREDIT_2210_10 (no flag). These are data observations, not precedence rules.

Retail layout checks pin fields to offsets 0x8..0x28 and the booleans to 0x38..0x3B; status records mark TCppStructOps<FGameDataTableRow_Credit>::Construct at 0x16c5a70 as MATCH. The generated Copy at 0x16c8d40 had a byte-DIFF verdict but is behavior-certified in current BEHAV status (engine TArray copy inlining). Those records support struct layout/copy fidelity, not a consumer or field semantics.
Do not treat exported values as constraints on other locales or builds: only this single CreditDataTable snapshot is present, and its non-empty Text values are already resolved strings.
The generated wiki page for this table lists only export field names with AI placeholder descriptions; it was not used as semantic evidence.

usages.detail: Declares FGameDataTableRow_Credit; lines 12-47 declare the 12 reflected fields and line 49 gives reconstructed defaults.
Declares the uint8 content enum and numeric values used by ContentType.
Retail reflection dump confirms the 12 properties in order and the uppercase serialized ID name.
Static assertions pin Id through Text to retail offsets 0x8..0x28.
Static assertions pin IsMain, IsShort, IsDlc1 and IsDlc2 to retail offsets 0x38..0x3B using SetBit-thunk evidence.
Reconstructed SetCreditType maps 0/1/2/3 to four prebuilt panels; the function reads no CreditDataTable row and is included only as a consumer limit.
Enum names Default/Short/Dlc1/Dlc2 corroborate the widget's four credit-type indices, not table flag consumption.
The only data-table read in the credit widget is BgmDataTable Duration for scroll timing, not a CreditDataTable lookup.
StartInitialLoading's explicit DataTable primary-asset names contain no CreditDataTable; no dedicated manager array or finder exists.
Generic DataTable primary-asset scan over /Game/DataTables covers the asset path without identifying a consumer.
Retail mount registry lists /Game/DataTables/CreditDataTable, confirming the asset's presence only.
Records the retail Construct verdict for FGameDataTableRow_Credit; Tools/verify/BEHAV/records/D08.json:1220 certifies Copy behavior despite the older byte DIFF.
